name: Jerusalem Post
text: Iran-backed militias in Iraq have accused the United States of violating their airspace as tensions rise, while the US Embassy issued an updated travel warning about terrorism risks.

name: Xinhua
text: The death toll from an attack on a church in Karak, Jordan, has risen to nine, and the king has promised a firm response.

name: Le Monde
text: Israeli forces have displaced hundreds of families in Hebron following a deadly attack, and Prime Minister Netanyahu has announced a large-scale operation in the West Bank.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Drone debris from an unidentified aircraft was found in Latvia's Alūksne district, and military and police have opened a joint investigation.

name: The Guardian
text: Ukraine's military says its Starlink satellite connection is stable again after recent restrictions, and President Zelenskyy thanked US allies for restoring the system.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: Baghdad reportedly suspects Israel struck Chinese-made air defence systems held by Iraqi armed factions.

name: The Hindu
text: Houthi-run media report Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa that killed at least 11 people, including three in a house strike, after missiles were intercepted.

name: SCMP
text: Houthi media say Saudi strikes in Sanaa killed 11 people on Saturday, shortly after the coalition said it intercepted two Houthi missiles.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: Saudi air defenses reportedly intercepted three missiles aimed at Riyadh, Taif and Yanbu.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: Hezbollah has renewed its pledge not to intervene militarily in support of Tehran.

name: Le Monde
text: Saudi forces carried out deadly airstrikes in Yemen, and the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two Houthi missiles aimed at the cities of Taif and Yanbu.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Iran says it will not let US warships approach closer, as Iranian officials and analysts see a possible war drawing nearer but no willingness to back down, while Trump considers new attacks.
